from pathlib import Path
import time,json,sys,os,hashlib
out=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(); binary=Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve(); deadline=time.monotonic()+900
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); snapshots=out/'snapshots'; snapshots.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
epoch=None; saved={}; ended=False
while time.monotonic()<deadline:
 if epoch is None:
  for proc in Path('/proc').glob('[0-9]*'):
   try:
    if Path(os.readlink(proc/'exe')).resolve()!=binary:continue
    args=(proc/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
    if str(out/'config').encode() not in args:continue
    stat=(proc/'stat').read_text();fields=stat[stat.rfind(')')+2:].split()
    epoch={'pid':int(proc.name),'start_ticks':int(fields[19]),'clock_ticks_per_second':os.sysconf('SC_CLK_TCK'),'boot_id':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),'command':[a.decode() for a in args if a],'executable_sha256':sha(binary.read_bytes())}
    (out/'process-epoch.json').write_text(json.dumps(epoch,indent=2)+'\n')
    env=dict(x.split(b'=',1) for x in (proc/'environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if b'=' in x)
    keep=['ASAN_OPTIONS','UBSAN_OPTIONS','SDL_VIDEODRIVER','LD_PRELOAD','LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE','OPENMW_M15_RUN_ID','OPENMW_M15_EPOCH']
    (out/'actual-engine-environment.json').write_text(json.dumps({k:env[k.encode()].decode() for k in keep if k.encode() in env},indent=2)+'\n')
   except (FileNotFoundError,PermissionError,ProcessLookupError):continue
 events=out/'events.jsonl'
 if events.exists():
  for line in events.read_text().splitlines():
   try:e=json.loads(line)
   except json.JSONDecodeError:continue
   if e['event']=='save-complete' and e['sequence'] not in saved:
    src=Path(e['save']); blob=src.read_bytes()
    if sha(blob)!=e['save_sha256']:raise RuntimeError('save overwritten before snapshot: '+str(e['sequence']))
    live=out/e['live']; assert sha(live.read_bytes())==e['live_sha256']
    target=snapshots/f"save-{e['sequence']}.omwsave"
    with target.open('xb') as f:f.write(blob)
    saved[e['sequence']]={'event':e,'snapshot':str(target),'sha256':sha(blob)}
    (out/'snapshot-index.json').write_text(json.dumps(saved,indent=2)+'\n')
   if e['event']=='run-end':ended=True
 if ended:break
 time.sleep(.02)
assert epoch and ended and saved, (epoch,ended,saved)
print(json.dumps({'epoch':epoch,'snapshots':list(saved),'run_end':ended},indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import copy, hashlib, json, math, struct, sys
from scripts.tes4_runtime_state import load_save, encode_payload, _find_runtime_record
base=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(); npc='content:oblivion.esm:01fc43'; player='dynamic:player:0000000000000001';drop='dynamic:native-reference:0000000000000001';shield='content:oblivion.esm:0352c1'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
fetch=lambda s,k,a=npc:next(x for x in s[k] if x['actor']==a)
ref=lambda s,k:next(x for x in s['references'] if x['key']==k)
f32=lambda x:struct.unpack('<f',struct.pack('<f',x))[0]
normalize=lambda items:sorted(items,key=lambda x:(x['base'],json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True)))
original=load_save(base/'staged-input.omwsave');assert original['schema_version']==53
assert sha((base/'staged-input.omwsave').read_bytes())=='4fa61d93a85c6184857ca7b9e593a7dee65776a610bc37d5aac0b57f60764dcb'
assert json.loads((base/'extra-content-reference-audit.json').read_text())['passed']
pre=None;post=None;epochs=[];reports=[]
for phase in ['first','second']:
 out=base/phase
 if not (out/'launcher.json').exists():break
 launcher=json.loads((out/'launcher.json').read_text());assert launcher['scenario_returncode']==launcher['monitor_returncode']==0
 assert json.loads((out/'scenario.json').read_text())['passed']
 epoch=json.loads((out/'process-epoch.json').read_text());epochs.append(epoch)
 pin=json.loads((base/'binary-pin.json').read_text());assert epoch['executable_sha256']==pin['sha256']==launcher['binary_sha256']
 if 'm15-sanitize' in pin['path']:
  env=json.loads((out/'actual-engine-environment.json').read_text());assert env['ASAN_OPTIONS']=='detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1' and env['UBSAN_OPTIONS']=='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1';assert env['LD_PRELOAD'].split(':')[0]=='/usr/lib64/libasan.so.8.0.0'
 events=[json.loads(x) for x in (out/'events.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];assert all(x['pid']==epoch['pid'] for x in events)
 assert events[0]['event']=='run-start' and events[-1]['event']=='run-end'
 pristine=out/'input-pristine.omwsave';initial=load_save(pristine);load=next(x for x in events if x['event']=='load-complete');assert load['save_sha256']==sha(pristine.read_bytes())
 live_blob=(out/load['live']).read_bytes();assert sha(live_blob)==load['live_sha256'];loaded=json.loads(live_blob)
 if phase=='first':assert pristine.read_bytes()==(base/'staged-input.omwsave').read_bytes()
 else:
  idx=json.loads((base/'first/snapshot-index.json').read_text());assert sha(pristine.read_bytes())==idx[max(idx,key=int)]['sha256']
  candidate=copy.deepcopy(initial)
  for key in ['native_melee_states','native_animation_clocks']:
   candidate[key]=[copy.deepcopy(fetch(loaded,key)) if x['actor']==npc else x for x in candidate[key]]
  candidate['native_loose_weapons']=copy.deepcopy(loaded['native_loose_weapons'])
  candidate['references']=[copy.deepcopy(ref(loaded,x['key'])) if x['key']==drop else x for x in candidate['references']]
  expected=copy.deepcopy(initial)
  for loose in expected['native_loose_weapons']:
   packed=loose['body']['native_packed_velocity']
   loose['body']['linear_velocity']=[f32(x*6.999040126800537) for x in packed['linear'][:3]]
   loose['body']['angular_velocity']=packed['angular'][:3]
  assert encode_payload(candidate)==encode_payload(expected),'Exact inactive NPC cache/clock, native body state and prescribed packed-to-world projection'
 idx=json.loads((out/'snapshot-index.json').read_text());assert len(idx)==(2 if phase=='first' else 1)
 checks=[]
 for sequence,row in sorted(idx.items(),key=lambda kv:int(kv[0])):
  blob=Path(row['snapshot']).read_bytes();assert sha(blob)==row['sha256']==row['event']['save_sha256']
  live=(out/row['event']['live']).read_bytes();assert sha(live)==row['event']['live_sha256'];state=load_save(Path(row['snapshot']));assert _find_runtime_record(blob)[3]==encode_payload(state)==encode_payload(json.loads(live))
  before_hit=phase=='first' and sequence==min(idx,key=int)
  assert state['schema_version']==61
  assert state['physical_actions']=={'next':2 if before_hit else 3,'pending':[]} and state['physical_action_owners']==[]
  assert state['combat_rng_state']==original['combat_rng_state']==505908858
  assert state['native_actor_life']==original['native_actor_life']
  for av in state['native_actor_values']:
   old=fetch(original,'native_actor_values',av['actor'])
   for index,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(old['values'],av['values'])):
    if not before_hit and index==8 and av['actor']==npc:
     assert a[:3]==b[:3] and struct.pack('<f',-b[3])==struct.pack('<I',1065809137)
    elif not before_hit and index==10 and av['actor'] in (npc,player):
     debit=struct.unpack('<f',struct.pack('<I',1067615414))[0] if av['actor']==npc else 7
     assert a[:3]==b[:3] and -debit-.0001<=b[3]<=0
    else:assert a==b,(av['actor'],index,a,b)
  assert state['player']['inventory']==original['player']['inventory']
  inventories={x['key']:copy.deepcopy(x['inventory']) for x in original['references'] if x['inventory']}
  if not before_hit:inventories[npc]=[x for x in inventories[npc] if x['base']!=shield]
  assert {x['key']:normalize(x['inventory']) for x in state['references'] if x['key'] in inventories}=={k:normalize(v) for k,v in inventories.items()}
  m=fetch(state,'native_melee_states');assert m['strike'] is None and m['reaction'] is None and m['first_person'] is None
  assert len(m['held_blocks'])==1;held=m['held_blocks'][0];assert held['animation_group']=='blockidle'
  if before_hit:
   pre=state
   assert fetch(state,'native_actor_values')['process_action']==6 and held['sequence_timing']['easing']
   assert not held['inactive'] and held['retirement'] is None and len(held['pose_snapshot']['tracks'])==64
   assert held['animation_time']==held['sequence_timing']['output_time']==0
   assert abs(held['sequence_timing']['ease_end']-held['sequence_timing']['ease_start']-8)<.00001
   assert state['next_dynamic_serial']==1 and state['native_loose_weapons']==[]
  else:
   assert pre is not None and fetch(state,'native_actor_values')['process_action']==-1
   old=copy.deepcopy(fetch(pre,'native_melee_states')['held_blocks'][0]);timing=old['sequence_timing']
   if timing['last_input'] is not None:timing['offset']=f32(float(timing['weighted_time'])-timing['last_input']+timing['offset'])
   timing['easing']=False;old['inactive']=True;old['pose_snapshot']=None
   candidate=copy.deepcopy(state);fetch(candidate,'native_melee_states')['held_blocks']=[old]
   assert encode_payload(candidate)==encode_payload(state),'Complete native zero-history expectation, including float bits'
   assert held['retirement'] is None
   if phase=='first':
    assert fetch(state,'native_animation_clocks')['clock']<old['sequence_timing']['ease_end'],'Reset must precede NI5 completion'
    post=state
   else:assert fetch(state,'native_melee_states')['held_blocks']==fetch(post,'native_melee_states')['held_blocks']
   assert state['next_dynamic_serial']==2 and len(state['native_loose_weapons'])==1
   loose=state['native_loose_weapons'][0];assert loose['reference']==drop and loose['base']==shield and loose['model']=='meshes/armor/iron/shield.nif'
   assert loose['asset_hash']=='f76af90c081974c7cab30aa7b1403e30' and loose['body']['record']==5 and loose['body']['node_record']==0
   d=ref(state,drop);assert d['base']==shield and d['item_condition']==0 and d['dropper']==npc and d['owner'] is None and not d['deleted'] and d['enabled'] and d['custom_state']['count']==1
   assert ref(state,npc)['dropped_items']==[drop]
   body=loose['body'];assert all(math.isfinite(x) for k in ['position','rotation','linear_velocity','angular_velocity'] for x in body[k])
   origin=ref(state,npc)['position'];position=body['position'];assert math.hypot(position[0]-origin[0],position[1]-origin[1])<=256 and -64<=position[2]-origin[2]<=192
   assert all(abs(a-b)<=.01 for a,b in zip(position,loose['root_local']['position']))
   assert all(abs(a-b)<=.01 for a,b in zip(d['position'][:3],loose['root_local']['position']))
  checks.append(dict(sequence=sequence,wire_exact=True,phase='NI5 before contact' if before_hit else 'native-zero inactive',pose_tracks=64 if before_hit else 0,clock=fetch(state,'native_animation_clocks')['clock'],held_timing=held['sequence_timing'],loose_count=len(state['native_loose_weapons'])))
 log=(out/'process.log').read_text();assert all(x not in log for x in ['ERROR: AddressSanitizer','runtime error:','Error in frame','onFrame failed'])
 assert log.count('M15 melee hit committed:')==(1 if phase=='first' else 0)
 assert log.count('M15 block begin: actor='+npc)==(1 if phase=='first' else 0)
 assert log.count('M15 block release: actor='+npc)==(1 if phase=='first' else 0)
 reports.append(dict(phase=phase,pid=epoch['pid'],binary_sha256=pin['sha256'],saves=checks,one_shield_drop_preserved_sword_and_no_replay=True))
if len(epochs)==2:assert (epochs[0]['pid'],epochs[0]['start_ticks'])!=(epochs[1]['pid'],epochs[1]['start_ticks'])
report=dict(passed=len(reports)==2,scope='NPC pending held shield break zero reset and fresh-process inactive cache/body preservation',phases=reports,full_M15S4_acceptance=False,limits='Authored public NPC block intent and Blend240; no full autonomous defense, original skin parity, settled body or uninterrupted trajectory equivalence.')
(base/'runtime-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,zlib,struct,sys,math
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5];sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from scripts.tes4_runtime_state import load_save
p=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve() if len(sys.argv)>1 else Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source=load_save(p/'staged-input.omwsave');original={v['key'] for v in source['references']}
states=[load_save(p/phase/'userdata/saves/M15Review/Quicksave.omwsave') for phase in ('first','second')]
extras=[{v['key']:v for v in s['references'] if v['key'] not in original and not v['key'].startswith('dynamic:')} for s in states]
wanted=set().union(*(set(int(k.rsplit(':',1)[1],16) for k in group) for group in extras))
master=Path('/home/maciek/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Oblivion/Data/Oblivion.esm');data=master.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()=='a26e21ea8c3041f8737ffb3a266129dedb7f8a88590625ecfecd5eb7f66b4a70'
found={};cells={}
def walk(start,end,cell=None,world=None):
 pos=start
 while pos<end:
  tag=data[pos:pos+4];size=struct.unpack_from('<I',data,pos+4)[0]
  if tag==b'GRUP':
   label,typ=struct.unpack_from('<II',data,pos+8);walk(pos+20,pos+size,label if typ==6 else cell,label if typ==1 else world);pos+=size;continue
  flags,form=struct.unpack_from('<II',data,pos+8)
  if tag==b'CELL' or (form in wanted and tag in (b'REFR',b'ACHR',b'ACRE')):
   body=data[pos+20:pos+20+size]
   if flags&0x40000:
    length=struct.unpack_from('<I',body)[0];body=zlib.decompress(body[4:]);assert len(body)==length
   q=0;fields={};extended=None
   while q<len(body):
    st=body[q:q+4];n=struct.unpack_from('<H',body,q+4)[0];q+=6
    if st==b'XXXX':extended=struct.unpack_from('<I',body,q)[0];q+=n;continue
    if extended is not None:n=extended;extended=None
    fields[st]=body[q:q+n];q+=n
   assert q==len(body)
   if tag==b'CELL':
    cells[form]={'world':world,'flags':flags,'interior':bool(fields[b'DATA'][0]&1),'coordinates':struct.unpack('<ii',fields[b'XCLC'][:8]) if b'XCLC' in fields else None}
   else:
    assert cell is not None
    found[form]={'base':struct.unpack('<I',fields[b'NAME'])[0],'cell':cell,'world':world,'flags':flags,'tag':tag.decode(),'position':struct.unpack('<6f',fields[b'DATA'])}
  pos+=20+size
 assert pos==end
walk(0,len(data));assert found.keys()==wanted
rows=[];resolved=[]
for phase,group in zip(('first','second'),extras):
 for key,ref in group.items():
  assert key.startswith('content:oblivion.esm:')
  native=found[int(key.rsplit(':',1)[1],16)]
  assert ref['base']==f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['base']:06x}"
  if ref['cell']!=f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['cell']:06x}":
   assert native['tag']=='REFR' and native['flags']&0x400
   parent=cells[native['cell']];assert parent['flags']&0x400 and not parent['interior']
   assert ref['cell'].startswith('content:oblivion.esm:')
   target_id=int(ref['cell'].rsplit(':',1)[1],16);target=cells[target_id]
   assert native['world'] is not None and parent['world']==native['world']==target['world']
   assert not target['interior'] and not target['flags']&0x400
   assert all(math.isfinite(x) for x in native['position'])
   assert ref['position'][:3]==list(native['position'][:3])
   physical_cell=tuple(math.floor(v/4096) for v in native['position'][:2]);assert target['coordinates']==physical_cell
   resolved.append({'phase':phase,'reference':key,'base':ref['base'],'world':f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['world']:06x}",'persistent_storage_cell':f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['cell']:06x}",'saved_physical_cell':ref['cell'],'coordinates':physical_cell,'unchanged_master_position':native['position'][:3]})
 rows.append({'count':len(group),'identity_base_cell_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted((k,r['base'],r['cell']) for k,r in group.items()),separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()})
r={'passed':True,'master_sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'counts':rows,'persistent_exterior_references':resolved,'scope':'Every added content reference has original master identity/base and parent CELL, or independently verified persistent exterior storage: original unchanged position resolves by floor(x/4096),floor(y/4096) to saved physical CELL in the same original worldspace. Both REFR and parent CELL must carry Persistent; target CELL must be nonpersistent exterior. Exactly one dynamic native-reference is checked separately. No unchanged whole-world cache-size claim.'}
(p/'extra-content-reference-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r))

    env=dict(x.split(b'=',1) for x in (proc/'environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if b'=' in x)
    keep=['ASAN_OPTIONS','UBSAN_OPTIONS','SDL_VIDEODRIVER','LD_PRELOAD','LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE','OPENMW_M15_RUN_ID','OPENMW_M15_EPOCH']
    (out/'actual-engine-environment.json').write_text(json.dumps({k:env[k.encode()].decode() for k in keep if k.encode() in env},indent=2)+'\n')
   except (FileNotFoundError,PermissionError,ProcessLookupError):continue
 events=out/'events.jsonl'
 if events.exists():
  for line in events.read_text().splitlines():
   try:e=json.loads(line)
   except json.JSONDecodeError:continue
   if e['event']=='save-complete' and e['sequence'] not in saved:
    src=Path(e['save']); blob=src.read_bytes()
    if sha(blob)!=e['save_sha256']:raise RuntimeError('save overwritten before snapshot: '+str(e['sequence']))
    live=out/e['live']; assert sha(live.read_bytes())==e['live_sha256']
    target=snapshots/f"save-{e['sequence']}.omwsave"
    with target.open('xb') as f:f.write(blob)
    saved[e['sequence']]={'event':e,'snapshot':str(target),'sha256':sha(blob)}
    (out/'snapshot-index.json').write_text(json.dumps(saved,indent=2)+'\n')
   if e['event']=='run-end':ended=True
 if ended:break
 time.sleep(.02)
assert epoch and ended and saved, (epoch,ended,saved)
print(json.dumps({'epoch':epoch,'snapshots':list(saved),'run_end':ended},indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import copy, hashlib, json, math, struct, sys
from scripts.tes4_runtime_state import load_save, encode_payload, _find_runtime_record

sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
fetch=lambda s,k,a=npc:next(x for x in s[k] if x['actor']==a)
ref=lambda s,k:next(x for x in s['references'] if x['key']==k)
f32=lambda x:struct.unpack('<f',struct.pack('<f',x))[0]
normalize=lambda items:sorted(items,key=lambda x:(x['base'],json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True)))
original=load_save(base/'staged-input.omwsave');assert original['schema_version']==53
assert sha((base/'staged-input.omwsave').read_bytes())=='4fa61d93a85c6184857ca7b9e593a7dee65776a610bc37d5aac0b57f60764dcb'
assert json.loads((base/'extra-content-reference-audit.json').read_text())['passed']
pre=None;post=None;epochs=[];reports=[]
for phase in ['first','second']:
 out=base/phase
 if not (out/'launcher.json').exists():break
 launcher=json.loads((out/'launcher.json').read_text());assert launcher['scenario_returncode']==launcher['monitor_returncode']==0
 assert json.loads((out/'scenario.json').read_text())['passed']
 epoch=json.loads((out/'process-epoch.json').read_text());epochs.append(epoch)
 pin=json.loads((base/'binary-pin.json').read_text());assert epoch['executable_sha256']==pin['sha256']==launcher['binary_sha256']
 if 'm15-sanitize' in pin['path']:
  env=json.loads((out/'actual-engine-environment.json').read_text());assert env['ASAN_OPTIONS']=='detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1' and env['UBSAN_OPTIONS']=='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1';assert env['LD_PRELOAD'].split(':')[0]=='/usr/lib64/libasan.so.8.0.0'
 events=[json.loads(x) for x in (out/'events.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];assert all(x['pid']==epoch['pid'] for x in events)
 assert events[0]['event']=='run-start' and events[-1]['event']=='run-end'
 pristine=out/'input-pristine.omwsave';initial=load_save(pristine);load=next(x for x in events if x['event']=='load-complete');assert load['save_sha256']==sha(pristine.read_bytes())
 live_blob=(out/load['live']).read_bytes();assert sha(live_blob)==load['live_sha256'];loaded=json.loads(live_blob)
 if phase=='first':assert pristine.read_bytes()==(base/'staged-input.omwsave').read_bytes()
 else:
  idx=json.loads((base/'first/snapshot-index.json').read_text());assert sha(pristine.read_bytes())==idx[max(idx,key=int)]['sha256']
  candidate=copy.deepcopy(initial)
  for key in ['native_melee_states','native_animation_clocks']:
   candidate[key]=[copy.deepcopy(fetch(loaded,key)) if x['actor']==npc else x for x in candidate[key]]
  candidate['native_loose_weapons']=copy.deepcopy(loaded['native_loose_weapons'])
  candidate['references']=[copy.deepcopy(ref(loaded,x['key'])) if x['key']==drop else x for x in candidate['references']]
  expected=copy.deepcopy(initial)
  for loose in expected['native_loose_weapons']:
   packed=loose['body']['native_packed_velocity']
   loose['body']['linear_velocity']=[f32(x*6.999040126800537) for x in packed['linear'][:3]]
   loose['body']['angular_velocity']=packed['angular'][:3]
  assert encode_payload(candidate)==encode_payload(expected),'Exact inactive NPC cache/clock, native body state and prescribed packed-to-world projection'
 idx=json.loads((out/'snapshot-index.json').read_text());assert len(idx)==(2 if phase=='first' else 1)
 checks=[]
 for sequence,row in sorted(idx.items(),key=lambda kv:int(kv[0])):
  blob=Path(row['snapshot']).read_bytes();assert sha(blob)==row['sha256']==row['event']['save_sha256']
  live=(out/row['event']['live']).read_bytes();assert sha(live)==row['event']['live_sha256'];state=load_save(Path(row['snapshot']));assert _find_runtime_record(blob)[3]==encode_payload(state)==encode_payload(json.loads(live))
  before_hit=phase=='first' and sequence==min(idx,key=int)
  assert state['schema_version']==61
  assert state['physical_actions']=={'next':2 if before_hit else 3,'pending':[]} and state['physical_action_owners']==[]
  assert state['combat_rng_state']==original['combat_rng_state']==505908858
  assert state['native_actor_life']==original['native_actor_life']
  for av in state['native_actor_values']:
   old=fetch(original,'native_actor_values',av['actor'])
   for index,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(old['values'],av['values'])):
    if not before_hit and index==8 and av['actor']==npc:
     assert a[:3]==b[:3] and struct.pack('<f',-b[3])==struct.pack('<I',1065809137)
    elif not before_hit and index==10 and av['actor'] in (npc,player):
     debit=struct.unpack('<f',struct.pack('<I',1067615414))[0] if av['actor']==npc else 7
     assert a[:3]==b[:3] and -debit-.0001<=b[3]<=0
    else:assert a==b,(av['actor'],index,a,b)
  assert state['player']['inventory']==original['player']['inventory']
  inventories={x['key']:copy.deepcopy(x['inventory']) for x in original['references'] if x['inventory']}
  if not before_hit:inventories[npc]=[x for x in inventories[npc] if x['base']!=shield]
  assert {x['key']:normalize(x['inventory']) for x in state['references'] if x['key'] in inventories}=={k:normalize(v) for k,v in inventories.items()}
  m=fetch(state,'native_melee_states');assert m['strike'] is None and m['reaction'] is None and m['first_person'] is None
  assert len(m['held_blocks'])==1;held=m['held_blocks'][0];assert held['animation_group']=='blockidle'
  if before_hit:
   pre=state
   assert fetch(state,'native_actor_values')['process_action']==6 and held['sequence_timing']['easing']
   assert not held['inactive'] and held['retirement'] is None and len(held['pose_snapshot']['tracks'])==64
   assert held['animation_time']==held['sequence_timing']['output_time']==0
   assert abs(held['sequence_timing']['ease_end']-held['sequence_timing']['ease_start']-8)<.00001
   assert state['next_dynamic_serial']==1 and state['native_loose_weapons']==[]
  else:
   assert pre is not None and fetch(state,'native_actor_values')['process_action']==-1
   old=copy.deepcopy(fetch(pre,'native_melee_states')['held_blocks'][0]);timing=old['sequence_timing']
   if timing['last_input'] is not None:timing['offset']=f32(float(timing['weighted_time'])-timing['last_input']+timing['offset'])
   timing['easing']=False;old['inactive']=True;old['pose_snapshot']=None
   candidate=copy.deepcopy(state);fetch(candidate,'native_melee_states')['held_blocks']=[old]
   assert encode_payload(candidate)==encode_payload(state),'Complete native zero-history expectation, including float bits'
   assert held['retirement'] is None
   if phase=='first':
    assert fetch(state,'native_animation_clocks')['clock']<old['sequence_timing']['ease_end'],'Reset must precede NI5 completion'
    post=state
   else:assert fetch(state,'native_melee_states')['held_blocks']==fetch(post,'native_melee_states')['held_blocks']
   assert state['next_dynamic_serial']==2 and len(state['native_loose_weapons'])==1
   loose=state['native_loose_weapons'][0];assert loose['reference']==drop and loose['base']==shield and loose['model']=='meshes/armor/iron/shield.nif'
   assert loose['asset_hash']=='f76af90c081974c7cab30aa7b1403e30' and loose['body']['record']==5 and loose['body']['node_record']==0
   d=ref(state,drop);assert d['base']==shield and d['item_condition']==0 and d['dropper']==npc and d['owner'] is None and not d['deleted'] and d['enabled'] and d['custom_state']['count']==1
   assert ref(state,npc)['dropped_items']==[drop]
   body=loose['body'];assert all(math.isfinite(x) for k in ['position','rotation','linear_velocity','angular_velocity'] for x in body[k])
   origin=ref(state,npc)['position'];position=body['position'];assert math.hypot(position[0]-origin[0],position[1]-origin[1])<=256 and -64<=position[2]-origin[2]<=192
   assert all(abs(a-b)<=.01 for a,b in zip(position,loose['root_local']['position']))
   assert all(abs(a-b)<=.01 for a,b in zip(d['position'][:3],loose['root_local']['position']))
  checks.append(dict(sequence=sequence,wire_exact=True,phase='NI5 before contact' if before_hit else 'native-zero inactive',pose_tracks=64 if before_hit else 0,clock=fetch(state,'native_animation_clocks')['clock'],held_timing=held['sequence_timing'],loose_count=len(state['native_loose_weapons'])))
 log=(out/'process.log').read_text();assert all(x not in log for x in ['ERROR: AddressSanitizer','runtime error:','Error in frame','onFrame failed'])
 assert log.count('M15 melee hit committed:')==(1 if phase=='first' else 0)
 assert log.count('M15 block begin: actor='+npc)==(1 if phase=='first' else 0)
 assert log.count('M15 block release: actor='+npc)==(1 if phase=='first' else 0)
 reports.append(dict(phase=phase,pid=epoch['pid'],binary_sha256=pin['sha256'],saves=checks,one_shield_drop_preserved_sword_and_no_replay=True))
if len(epochs)==2:assert (epochs[0]['pid'],epochs[0]['start_ticks'])!=(epochs[1]['pid'],epochs[1]['start_ticks'])
report=dict(passed=len(reports)==2,scope='NPC pending held shield break zero reset and fresh-process inactive cache/body preservation',phases=reports,full_M15S4_acceptance=False,limits='Authored public NPC block intent and Blend240; no full autonomous defense, original skin parity, settled body or uninterrupted trajectory equivalence.')
(base/'runtime-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,zlib,struct,sys,math
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5];sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from scripts.tes4_runtime_state import load_save
p=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve() if len(sys.argv)>1 else Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source=load_save(p/'staged-input.omwsave');original={v['key'] for v in source['references']}
states=[load_save(p/phase/'userdata/saves/M15Review/Quicksave.omwsave') for phase in ('first','second')]
extras=[{v['key']:v for v in s['references'] if v['key'] not in original and not v['key'].startswith('dynamic:')} for s in states]
wanted=set().union(*(set(int(k.rsplit(':',1)[1],16) for k in group) for group in extras))
master=Path('/home/maciek/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Oblivion/Data/Oblivion.esm');data=master.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()=='a26e21ea8c3041f8737ffb3a266129dedb7f8a88590625ecfecd5eb7f66b4a70'
found={};cells={}
def walk(start,end,cell=None,world=None):
 pos=start
 while pos<end:
  tag=data[pos:pos+4];size=struct.unpack_from('<I',data,pos+4)[0]
  if tag==b'GRUP':
   label,typ=struct.unpack_from('<II',data,pos+8);walk(pos+20,pos+size,label if typ==6 else cell,label if typ==1 else world);pos+=size;continue
  flags,form=struct.unpack_from('<II',data,pos+8)
  if tag==b'CELL' or (form in wanted and tag in (b'REFR',b'ACHR',b'ACRE')):
   body=data[pos+20:pos+20+size]
   if flags&0x40000:
    length=struct.unpack_from('<I',body)[0];body=zlib.decompress(body[4:]);assert len(body)==length
   q=0;fields={};extended=None
   while q<len(body):
    st=body[q:q+4];n=struct.unpack_from('<H',body,q+4)[0];q+=6
    if st==b'XXXX':extended=struct.unpack_from('<I',body,q)[0];q+=n;continue
    if extended is not None:n=extended;extended=None
    fields[st]=body[q:q+n];q+=n
   assert q==len(body)
   if tag==b'CELL':
    cells[form]={'world':world,'flags':flags,'interior':bool(fields[b'DATA'][0]&1),'coordinates':struct.unpack('<ii',fields[b'XCLC'][:8]) if b'XCLC' in fields else None}
   else:
    assert cell is not None
    found[form]={'base':struct.unpack('<I',fields[b'NAME'])[0],'cell':cell,'world':world,'flags':flags,'tag':tag.decode(),'position':struct.unpack('<6f',fields[b'DATA'])}
  pos+=20+size
 assert pos==end
walk(0,len(data));assert found.keys()==wanted
rows=[];resolved=[]
for phase,group in zip(('first','second'),extras):
 for key,ref in group.items():
  assert key.startswith('content:oblivion.esm:')
  native=found[int(key.rsplit(':',1)[1],16)]
  assert ref['base']==f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['base']:06x}"
  if ref['cell']!=f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['cell']:06x}":
   assert native['tag']=='REFR' and native['flags']&0x400
   parent=cells[native['cell']];assert parent['flags']&0x400 and not parent['interior']
   assert ref['cell'].startswith('content:oblivion.esm:')
   target_id=int(ref['cell'].rsplit(':',1)[1],16);target=cells[target_id]
   assert native['world'] is not None and parent['world']==native['world']==target['world']
   assert not target['interior'] and not target['flags']&0x400
   assert all(math.isfinite(x) for x in native['position'])
   assert ref['position'][:3]==list(native['position'][:3])
   physical_cell=tuple(math.floor(v/4096) for v in native['position'][:2]);assert target['coordinates']==physical_cell
   resolved.append({'phase':phase,'reference':key,'base':ref['base'],'world':f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['world']:06x}",'persistent_storage_cell':f"content:oblivion.esm:{native['cell']:06x}",'saved_physical_cell':ref['cell'],'coordinates':physical_cell,'unchanged_master_position':native['position'][:3]})
 rows.append({'count':len(group),'identity_base_cell_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted((k,r['base'],r['cell']) for k,r in group.items()),separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()})
r={'passed':True,'master_sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'counts':rows,'persistent_exterior_references':resolved,'scope':'Every added content reference has original master identity/base and parent CELL, or independently verified persistent exterior storage: original unchanged position resolves by floor(x/4096),floor(y/4096) to saved physical CELL in the same original worldspace. Both REFR and parent CELL must carry Persistent; target CELL must be nonpersistent exterior. Exactly one dynamic native-reference is checked separately. No unchanged whole-world cache-size claim.'}
(p/'extra-content-reference-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r))
